reason: DIRECTOR_REQUIRES_PRODUCT_OR_ARCHITECT_CHOICE: MVP5 analysis showed closure latency dominated by control/evidence orchestration rather than product implementation. The current Harness rejects stronger Work Order predicate refinements by exact-list equality, allows a preferred unavailable verifier route to stall in practice, and an exact-SHA control-drive job runs on detached HEAD even though Drive requires the declared branch identity.
decision_required: Authorize a bounded Harness/control repair that preserves exact-head evidence, independent roles, full required product gates and the single runtime mutation writer while allowing stronger acceptance refinements, parallel read-only post-freeze gates, fail-forward verifier routing and branch-aware control-drive execution.
recommendation_reason: The repair removes orchestration false negatives and waiting without weakening runtime acceptance, ownership, review independence or canonical-main merge gates.
resolution: AUTHORIZE_BOUNDED_CLOSURE_THROUGHPUT_REPAIR. Пользователь явно поручил внести правки, чтобы ускорить закрытие пунктов и убрать бюрократию после анализа MVP5. Repair оформляется как bounded amendment существующего V0-MVP-R1-WO-001, а не как второй active Work Order. Разрешены только Harness/control/policy/test/workflow изменения, перечисленные в amended parent scope; runtime gameplay, canonical owners, architecture ownership, acceptance threshold weakening, main merge и self-acceptance не разрешены.
